entities.summary: Michael J. Reilly Jr. is an American professional ice hockey player who is a defenseman for the Carolina Hurricanes of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the fourth round, 98th overall, by the Columbus Blue Jackets in the 2011 NHL entry draft and has previously played for the Minnesota Wild, Montreal Canadiens, Ottawa Senators, Boston Bruins, Florida Panthers and New York Islanders.
